title: thelysia palaestina
intro: Thelysia palaestina, commonly known as the Middle Eastern thelysia or Middle Eastern false chamomile, is a flowering plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the ability to treat anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Thelysia palaestina include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Thelysia palaestina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
